Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.lifecycle

Interface ShadowListener

public interface ShadowListener
Observer callback fired after a shadow inference call completes (or fails), letting you wire up comparison logging/metrics between a primary version and a shadow version without changing LifecycleManager or ManagedModel.

Shadow calls run asynchronously and never affect what's returned to the caller of ManagedModel.infer(java.util.Map) — this listener is purely observational.

Since:
0.1.0

      void onShadowResult(String modelId, String shadowVersion, InferenceResult primaryResult, InferenceResult shadowResult, Throwable error)
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id the shadow deployment belongs to
      shadowVersion - the shadow version string that produced (or attempted) this result
      primaryResult - the result the caller actually received, from the primary/canary engine
      shadowResult - the shadow engine's result, or null if the shadow call failed
      error - the failure from the shadow call, or null if it succeeded
